headline: Does Google even want to win at AI?
summary: Google's AI strategy faces intense scrutiny after a major reorganization of its DeepMind division. Senior AI reporter Hayden Field discusses if Google is losing the AI race. The company's chief scientist, Jeff Dean, has also transitioned roles, sparking further questions.

headline: Rivian is finally getting a long-requested feature — and no, it’s not CarPlay
summary: Rivian R1S owners will finally receive second-row captain's chairs, a highly requested feature. This upgrade addresses long-standing complaints about the three-row SUV's bench seating. The new standalone seats are expected to improve comfort and utility for families.

headline: Wearables are getting a taste of much-needed minimalism
summary: A growing trend in wearables is moving towards screenless, minimalist designs. This approach prioritizes discreet health tracking over constant notifications and screen interaction. Devices like smart rings and simplified fitness trackers are leading this charge.

headline: Samsung’s $1,900 Z Fold 8 is still vulnerable to pocket lint
summary: iFixit has given Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 a provisional repairability score of 4 out of 10. The expensive foldable phone's hinge remains susceptible to dust and sand due to its IP48 ingress rating. This highlights a persistent design flaw despite its premium price tag.

headline: Nautus: Echoes from Below Announced for PC
summary: Magic Design Studios, creators of 'Have a Nice Death,' unveiled their new project: 'Nautus: Echoes from Below.' The game offers unique double-sided exploration, balancing a cozy island surface with mysterious underwater adventures. It supports solo or four-player co-op and is in development for PC.

headline: Kinetic Publishing 2026 Showcase Roundup
summary: Kinetic Publishing presented its 2026 showcase, highlighting upcoming titles and developments. The event featured a range of new game announcements. This roundup covers all the key reveals and updates from the presentation.

headline: Rob Zombie’s Firefly Horror Movie Trilogy Gets an Ultimate 4K Collection
summary: Rob Zombie's iconic Firefly horror movie trilogy is set to receive an ultimate 4K collection. The set includes 'House of 1000 Corpses,' 'The Devil's Rejects,' and '3 From Hell.' Fans can pre-order the collection now, which promises bonus items.

headline: DC Has a Whole Bunch of Hardcover Comics on Sale at Amazon Today
summary: Amazon is currently offering significant discounts on a wide selection of DC hardcover comics. Top titles like 'Absolute Batman Vol. 1 & 2' are included in the limited-time sale. Fans can also find deals on 'Absolute Wonder Woman' and 'All-Star Superman' today.

headline: Water bills set to rise for many after firms permitted extra funding
summary: Ofwat has provisionally approved 13 water companies to increase customer charges. The extra funding is intended to support investments in infrastructure and service improvements. This decision means many households will likely see an increase in their water bills.

headline: Son pays tribute to dad, 102, who died after allegedly being assaulted in pub
summary: Phillip Ormerod, a 102-year-old man, has died after an alleged assault at a pub. His son has shared an emotional tribute to his father. Police have confirmed the death and are investigating the incident.

headline: The key signs you may have damaged your eyes by looking at the eclipse
summary: Experts are outlining crucial signs of potential eye damage from viewing the sun without proper eclipse glasses. Symptoms can include blurred vision, headaches, and sensitivity to light. Immediate medical attention is advised if these symptoms appear after an eclipse.

headline: Busiest ever period for England's A&Es as extreme heat hits
summary: England's A&E departments experienced their busiest period on record, with over 2.4 million visits in each of the last three months. Extreme heat is identified as a significant factor contributing to the surge in emergency admissions. Unions are raising concerns about inhumane conditions for both patients and staff.
